title: Strict Beck–Fiala rounding for incidence matrices
abstract: Proves the rational integer-making form of Beck–Fiala rounding for finite zero-one incidence matrices with column degree bounded by a positive t. Every row has discrepancy strictly less than t, and initially integral coordinates are preserved. Includes the necessity of the positive-bound hypothesis. This is distinct from the Komlós discrepancy bound and from the non-strict hyperedge-selection rounding used in triangle packing.

informal.BeckFialaMatrix.exists_rounding: Given a finite zero-one integer matrix with at most t ones per column, t at least one, and a rational vector in the unit cube, there is a zero-one integer vector whose discrepancy in every row is strictly less than t.
informal.BeckFialaMatrix.exists_rounding_preservi: The strict rounding can additionally be chosen to leave every initially integral coordinate unchanged.
informal.BeckFialaMatrix.zero_bound_counterexampl: The same universally quantified strict rounding claim without the assumption t at least one is false, already for a one-by-one zero matrix with t equal to zero.
